footnote_text: Represents a bona fide gift of 500 shares directly held by the reporting person to a donor-advised fund at the Community Foundation of Middle Tennessee. || On November 4, 2026, the reporting person also transferred 22,506 shares of common stock previously held directly to the Gerald W & Elizabeth W Sims Revocable Trust, a revocable trust of which the reporting person and her spouse are the trustees and the lifetime beneficiaries. The transfer was made for no consideration and effected only a change in the form of beneficial ownership without changing the reporting person's pecuniary interest in the shares, and accordingly is exempt from Section 16 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, pursuant to Rule 16a-13 thereunder.
